customerToAccounts.description: One customer can hold multiple accounts.

accountToTransactions.description: Every transaction belongs to one account.

transactionToMerchant.description: Purchases and refunds can link to a merchant; transfers can remain merchantless.

transactionToSettlement.description: A transaction can produce at most one settlement record.

transactionToFraudFlag.description: A transaction can carry at most one review flag.

limitations: The repository dataset is synthetic and demonstrates analytical workflows rather than real customer behaviour.
Currency values are aggregated nominally; no foreign-exchange conversion is applied.
Fraud flags are generated, randomly sampled review signals and must not be interpreted as confirmed fraud or predictive risk.
